disclosures.title: Fixed-services expansion outlook
disclosures.body_text: GO identifies an opportunity to expand fixed-line services and increase market share by targeting businesses, individuals and households.

disclosures.title: Fiber broadband demand outlook
disclosures.body_text: GO plans to meet rising fiber demand with multiple speeds and packages and to expand technical solutions and connectivity services.

disclosures.title: Business-sector offering outlook
disclosures.body_text: The company intends to continue focusing on the business sector with advanced technical solutions, fiber and wireless connectivity.

disclosures.title: SD-WAN revenue opportunity
disclosures.body_text: The issuer expects the new SD-WAN service to create revenue opportunities in the coming year.

disclosures.title: Network-upgrade second phase
disclosures.body_text: After completing the initial core and distribution upgrade phase, GO is preparing to launch the second phase.

disclosures.title: Cloud-services expansion
disclosures.body_text: Following completion of two phases, GO continues expanding cloud capacity and integrated solutions.

disclosures.title: Data-center modernization
disclosures.body_text: GO launched a project to upgrade its Tier III data center using current hardware and systems.

disclosures.title: IT systems second phase
disclosures.body_text: GO is finalizing the second phase of its IT systems upgrade after completing phase one.

disclosures.title: Community initiatives outlook
disclosures.body_text: The company intends to continue launching community initiatives addressing societal needs.

disclosures.title: FY2026 budget approval
disclosures.body_text: The Board approved the FY2025/2026 annual budget; no amount or earnings forecast is disclosed.

disclosures.title: Competition risk
disclosures.body_text: Price competition and discounting may affect projected market share and customer acquisition.

disclosures.title: Cybersecurity and fraud risk
disclosures.body_text: GO reports internal and external fraud and cybersecurity exposures and related controls.

disclosures.title: Technology substitution risk
disclosures.body_text: ICT advances and competing access technologies may reshape the competitive landscape.

disclosures.title: Human-capital risk
disclosures.body_text: Competition for skilled labor and rising compensation create recruitment and retention risk.

disclosures.title: Regulatory and spectrum risk
disclosures.body_text: The company is exposed to telecommunications regulation, licensing and spectrum obligations.

disclosures.title: Supplier and service dependency risk
disclosures.body_text: Network operations depend on suppliers, partners, content, applications and devices.

disclosures.title: Liquidity and financing risk
disclosures.body_text: The company manages operating cash flow and redirects shortfalls toward debt management.

disclosures.title: Unmodified FY2025 audit opinion
disclosures.body_text: Crowe opined that the consolidated statements present fairly, in all material respects, under IFRS endorsed in Saudi Arabia and SOCPA pronouncements.
